The '''Witch Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When describing [[Eerie Coulee Disorder]], the unease most [[Human/Legends|human]]s and [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]s experience when seeing a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that looks human but not quite, [[I-5YQ|I-Five]] referred to the Witch Nebula as a classic example of [[pareidolia]], or the phenomenon of seeing complex images in simple stimuli.<ref name="TLJ">''[[The Last Jedi (novel)|The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
